questions.question: How should a selected US information provider separate subscription, usage and setup revenue at the contract and period boundary?

questions.question: When a bundle combines software access, hosting, telecom or content, how should provider presentation stay separate from customer software expenditure?
questions.scope: Selected US provider and customer roles under US GAAP; bundle includes hosted access, licensed content, connectivity or implementation; reseller/intermediary counterexample included.
questions.answer: Decompose the provider bundle using the contract and role evidence, then assess whether the provider controls the promised service before transfer. The provider revenue analysis is separate from the customer’s accounting for acquired software, hosting fees or implementation costs. A reseller invoice is not automatically gross revenue, and a customer’s prepaid or implementation amount is not automatically the provider’s earned revenue.

questions.question: How does a family office define ownership and reporting boundaries?
questions.scope: US office service company, domestic investment LLC taxed as a partnership, Texas domestic non-grantor complex trust, and individual; synthetic September 2026 close. Tax coordination uses explicitly selected 2025 IRS instructions as prior-year routing, not 2026 return instructions.
questions.answer: Maintain separate office-company, individual, trust/estate, investment-entity and underlying property or operating ledgers. questions.question: How should family office shared costs and personal spending remain traceable?
questions.scope: US office service company, domestic investment LLC taxed as a partnership, Texas domestic non-grantor complex trust, and individual; synthetic September 2026 close. Tax coordination uses explicitly selected 2025 IRS instructions as prior-year routing, not 2026 return instructions.

questions.question: How can a family office reconcile a supplemental family statement without double counting?
questions.scope: US office service company, domestic investment LLC taxed as a partnership, Texas domestic non-grantor complex trust, and individual; synthetic September 2026 close. Tax coordination uses explicitly selected 2025 IRS instructions as prior-year routing, not 2026 return instructions.
questions.answer: Complete separate bank, custodian and ledger reconciliations, then define the included accounts and purpose of a supplemental view. Remove duplicated interests only where the underlying entity is also included, match interentity balances, and distinguish internal fees and beneficiary transfers from external activity. Retain the entity trial balances and an adjustment log. The original four-entity example shows a balanced carrying-value aggregation, including restricted trust resources and an unresolved valuation exception; it is not an individual’s net worth or a final GAAP financial statement. Payment-authority and sensitive-data controls are editorial proposals.
